note: v1 85.029 on seed 0, 85.179 on seed 11: Window Seat, night-bus 2-step (147 s, 136 bpm, F# minor). A shuffled 2-step (kick on 1 and a skip-kick that wanders bar by bar, claps on 2 and 4, off-16th hats swung 0.7, a shaker on a 3-sixteenth cycle across the bar) under a worn F#m9 | Dmaj9 | Bm11 | C#7sus juno loop through wM's tape deck; wordless CHOPS on a song-local voice (one syllable each, la / mo / ye, a falling 9th-5th-3rd cell after the claps); THE STOP, a half-time B section on rhodes over Dmaj9 | E6/9 | C#m7 | Bm9; a beatless breakdown of pads and voices; the last groove with the chops an octave up; vinyl on the master. From the first draft 73.86: the B section (recurrence 13.5 -> 71.7: every later section had matched an earlier one at 0.8-0.9), the sub up and the 280 Hz mud out (spectrum 85.5 -> 96.5), +2 dB (rms -18.7 -> in range), the shaker cycle (variety 80 -> 87).
next: rhythm 59 (off-grid 0.01: the kick/clap grid swamps the shuffle - the cross-rhythm needs a louder voice that does not flatten the sections); the chops' syllables and register; Harry's ear.
